answer: An OFT token moves across chains, and the transfer proof shows the burn on one side and the mint on the other. The proof is verified by the receiving chain, and the supply is conserved across both sides. A farm needs 192 separate transfer proofs, since one burn cannot mint 192 tokens. A dawn marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the fable ledger turns 192 aliases into 192 bills while the comet path for the honest stays a single payment.
